title: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server DeviceLogUploadServlet Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the DeviceLogUploadServlet class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
